datasets.name: Sentinel-1A SAR imagery (IW GRD)
datasets.verbatim: This study utilized Interferometric Wide (IW) Ground Range Detected (GRD) images from Sentinel-1. These data can be downloaded from the European Space Agency’s Science Data Center at https://scihub.copernicus.eu/ (accessed on 1 October 2023).

datasets.name: SRTM 30 m Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
datasets.verbatim: Lastly, we employ the SRTM 30 m Digital Elevation Model (DEM) for terrain correction, transforming the backscatter coefficient data from the Ground Range Geometry to terrain-corrected coordinates.

datasets.name: Landslide inventory of Hokkaido (2018)
datasets.verbatim: In the Hokkaido event experiment, we utilized landslide data created by Wang et al. [59]

methods.name: Dual-Polarized Pixel Attention UNet (DPPA-UNet)
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation model based on UNet that incorporates a pixel-wise attention module at each upsampling stage. It takes fused ascending and descending time-series SAR backscatter coefficients (VV and VH) as input to produce landslide probability maps.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes an innovative dual-polarization SAR image landslide recognition method... we constructed a dual-polarized pixel attention UNet model considering multi-temporal image features.

availability.author_statement: Data supporting the findings of this study can be requested from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the custom DPPA-UNet code is not available via any repository or persistent link. Input datasets are accessible, with Sentinel-1 imagery linked and SRTM DEM data considered practically accessible via public providers.
